# §6 Demand Signal Intelligence — Highlight Candidates

1. **2:35 average session depth signals active product research** — Across seven months of portal analytics, visitors averaged 2 minutes 35 seconds and 4.0 pages per visit, consistent with deliberate product evaluation by a concentrated audience of 1–2 daily researchers. [→ §portal]
2. **January research spike: 3:41 sessions, 288 pageviews** — January 2026 saw the deepest engagement of the trailing period, with session duration 43% above the seven-month average and the highest monthly pageview count. [→ §portal]
3. **Engagement moderation since January peak** — Session depth declined 40% from January (3:41) to May (2:12), and monthly pageviews dropped from 288 to 136, suggesting the January–February window may represent a seasonal research cycle. [→ §portal]
